semiconductor_relevance: High — ELS System Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing automated photo process equipment for the semiconductor industry.
summary: ELS System Technology Co., Ltd. is a provider of fully automated photo process mass-production equipment tailored for the semiconductor and optoelectronic industries. The company focuses on developing customized solutions such as Spin Coaters, Mask Aligners, and other lithography track systems to meet specific customer requirements.
capabilities: Fully automated photo process mass-production equipment

regional_presence.Taiwan: ELS was established to support the localization of high-level equipment in Taiwan's semiconductor and optoelectronic industries.
